observed_value: fair_value_currency extracted as non-USD units: U_AUD, U_CAD, U_EUR, U_CHF, U_GBP
anchor_value: schedule fair value columns are USD-denominated, shown by dollar-signed country and investment totals

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Ancora Bidco PTY LTD row has AUD only in Principal Amount/Par/Shares, with Fair Value 3,497 in the Fair Value column.
Total Debt Investments Australia shows Cost $ 3,355 and Fair Value $ 3,504.
Avidity Acquisition B.V. row has EUR only in Principal Amount/Par/Shares, with Fair Value 145 in the Fair Value column.
Total Debt Investments Netherlands shows Cost $ 12,373 and Fair Value $ 13,346.
Solvias AG LP row has CHF only in Principal Amount/Par/Shares, with Fair Value 11,617 in the Fair Value column.
Total Debt Investments Switzerland shows Cost $ 9,953 and Fair Value $ 11,617.
Hamsard 3778 Limited row has GBP only in Principal Amount/Par/Shares, with Fair Value 3,837 in the Fair Value column.
Total Debt Investments United Kingdom shows Cost $ 11,620 and Fair Value $ 12,075.

findings.detail: The extractor assigned the local currency shown in the principal amount column to fair_value_currency even though fair value is in the schedule's dollar-denominated Fair Value column.

rationale: FX02 is a real data error. The raw schedule headings separate Principal Amount, Par Value or Shares from Cost and Fair Value. Rows with local-currency principal amounts, such as AUD, EUR, CHF, and GBP, still roll up to country totals where the Cost and Fair Value columns are explicitly dollar-signed. The stored fair_value_currency values therefore came from the principal/par unit rather than the fair value unit.
